result.title: Forehead ROI Localization under Real-World Imaging Degradations via Cross-View Pseudo-Labeling
result.comment: 9 pages, submitted and accepted to the 2027 IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision Workshops (WACVW)
result.summary: Forehead region-of-interest (ROI) localization is important for forehead-creases biometrics, particularly when the lower face is occluded. However, localization remains challenging under varying image quality, pose, and illumination. We propose Confidence and Consistency Guided Pseudo-Labeling (CCGP), which adapts Grounding DINO using unlabeled facial images filtered by detection confidence and geometric consistency between original and horizontally flipped views, without modifying the detector architecture or loss. We evaluate CCGP on five external datasets and 350 images spanning seven imaging conditions. CCGP achieves the highest mean intersection over union (mIoU) on four of five external datasets, improving from 0.415 to 0.580 on RMFRD compared with supervised Grounding DINO. On the quality-stratified subset, the largest gains occur under blur (0.487 to 0.719) and low contrast (0.615 to 0.710). CCGP also outperforms conventional self-training on RMFRD (0.580 versus 0.551 mIoU). Despite a slight in-domain performance gap (0.861 vs. 0.866 mIoU) and challenges with off-angle poses, CCGP improves cross-dataset localization under challenging imaging conditions.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出置信度与一致性引导的伪标签方法（CCGP），用原图与水平翻转视图的检测置信度和几何一致性筛选无标签人脸图像，以适配 Grounding DINO 实现额头 ROI 定位。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于人脸生物特征检测中的域适应与伪标签工作，虽涉及视觉证据定位，但不研究推理期 latent 状态、证据筛选决策或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等机制，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系；其跨视图一致性过滤或可作极弱线索，但材料未显示与推理状态使用相关。
